reporting_policy: Every user-facing project progress output should report at minimum requirements_structure_percent, g1_system_freeze_percent and backlog_done_percent. Broader engineering percentages must be explicitly labeled estimates.

requirements_structure.meaning: Planned requirement-domain hierarchy/schema/authority coverage, not product-value closure.

g1_system_freeze.note: PB-05 freezes >=5.0 kWh gross rated pack energy, a 54.0 V minimum loaded bus for full rated-power operation and >=500 A continuous pack-current capability. The existing G1 matrix directly closes G1C-02 from the 54 V floor; exact pack MPN/mass/peak current and protection details remain open. PASS means controlled value closure/traceability, not physical verification.

backlog.note: Conservative metric: only tasks explicitly marked DONE are counted. S1.3 advanced materially, but UAV-005/UAV-006 remain IN_PROGRESS until exact pack mass/cold-aged sag/BMS/peak-current and PWM/protection/thermal parents close.

gate_closure.note: G0/G1 remain OPEN because mass allocation, environment, exact pack implementation/peak current, PWM, protection and thermal requirements remain unresolved. G2-G7 remain dependency-blocked.
